item.title: Generative AI and Data Envelopment Analysis for Performance Measurement and Public Value
item.content:encoded:
This special issue explores the intersection of generative artificial intelligence and data envelopment analysis as tools for measuring organizational performance and creating public value. The collection seeks research that demonstrates how these technologies can enhance performance evaluation methodologies and provide insights into efficiency across various sectors, particularly in public organizations where value creation extends beyond traditional financial metrics.

Appel publié par Socio-Economic Planning Sciences. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Applications of generative AI in performance measurement
  • Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA) methodologies
  • Public value creation and assessment
  • Integration of AI and DEA techniques
  • Performance evaluation in public sector organizations
  • Efficiency measurement using advanced analytics

item.title: Data Envelopment Analysis at Fifty: From efficiency measurement to intelligent data-enabled analytics and decision making
item.content:encoded:
This special issue celebrates the 55th anniversary of Omega journal and marks fifty years since the introduction of Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA). The special issue seeks to showcase the evolution of DEA from its origins as a tool for efficiency measurement to its current applications in intelligent data-enabled analytics and decision making.

Appel publié par Omega. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.
